support.certification: Architectural game-space contacts only, not structural load adequacy

roof.limit: Do not blanket the 15.5m outboard support gap with an opaque overhang across selected windows; keep transverse transfer frames above the view edges. Maintain general ship height118m including keel bottom−3.5.

programme_adoption: Parent updates only these six current programme boundaries/owners after integration and tests, retaining original historical envelopes. Bridge briefing relocation must retire old future ownership metadata without moving the existing starboard house cover.
source_and_qa: Editable closed outward Blender parts, metric UVs, bounded spatial batches, exact source/export agreement, door and window joins without slits, clear source fixture markers. Parent owns Godot integration and physical acceptance.
reference_application: Window composition/profile and ceiling integration before furnishings. Use original stylized materials and restrained geometry rather than copying photoreal detail. Staff command rooms remain distinct from guest resort spaces.

collision_policy: All named CMD_CELL meshes concave static surfaces, including visibly present glazing. No floor slab, static duplicate leaves, convex fill, door script, furniture or commands included.
